title: Australian Beef Stew
description: A hearty, slow-cooked stew originating from Australia, perfect for a cold day, inspired by German cooking techniques.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onions and garlic until softened.
Add the carrots and potatoes; cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, browned beef, and salt. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2.5 hours, or until the meat is tender.
